preconditions.description: The input integers n and k must satisfy the condition that k is a positive integer less than n, and n is at most 100000.

postconditions.expression: len(set(abs(p[i] - p[i+1]) for i in range(n-1))) == k
postconditions.description: The output permutation must have exactly k distinct absolute differences between consecutive elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n)) and len(set(p)) == n
postconditions.description: The output permutation must consist of n distinct positive integers not larger than n.
